warning.titlePre: Jaguar XKR Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your XKR is an X150-generation model with the AJ133 supercharged 5.0-litre V8 — that's the 2005–2014 generation — the timing chain tensioner and guide design flaw is a well-documented pattern on this engine. The hardened steel tensioner piston wears an aluminium guide button over time and can fail with no warning. This exact engine was part of a US class-action lawsuit covering multiple JLR models. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guide rails as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (au7o.io, rrsport.co.uk lawsuit list), per VRF-jaguar-xk.md.
